implementation_plan: Replace the client-only root redirect and add the missing blog heading, then validate rendered metadata, headings, sitemap membership, and lastmod coverage.
Keep sitemap exclusion separate from robots indexability, emit zero noindex directives across every rendered HTML route, and restore all public libnetdata references to the sitemap.
Persist upstream sidebar ordering with exact source and corpus provenance, then make full ingest and grid-only recovery use one reconciliation and finalization path.
Paginate every generated integration grid above the 175-card page capacity, emit every card exactly once, and safely reconcile grid creation, removal, and page-count transitions.
Treat only explicit generated_grid_page ownership markers as authority to overwrite or delete a grid artifact; never infer ownership from status or component imports.
Reject symbolic links, non-regular files, and paths whose real ancestors escape the configured docs root before any recovery read, hash, write, replacement, or deletion.
Replace random installer control IDs with React useId and prove uniqueness, label binding, repeatable SSR, and hydration stability.
Expand the rendered-link gate to same-host HTTP links and terminal-wildcard redirect sources, then pin parser boundaries with mutations.

Repair the complete Netlify redirect graph from its static owner: restore every historical Network Flows route, retarget every proved dead exact destination, replace non-terminal wildcard classes with archived exact mappings, remove duplicate and conflicting identities, and fail closed on graph regressions.
Run all Learn and exact-source tests, two byte-identical production builds, rendered audits, provenance checks, and repository hygiene checks.

Vendor the exact C8 ruleset-v8 bundle accepted in netdata/seo commit 0849022df128b87ad0ae0a829a5e444408e4937f with the canonical exporter. Every Netlify context performs a clean locked Node 22 install in that bundle, builds Docusaurus, and scans the complete build with the Learn origin and a read-only, reasoned baseline containing only exact pre-existing findings.

Replace the legacy Learn IndexNow copy with every checksum-covered schema-2 artifact, dependency, verifier rule, and adversarial test from the website owner commit 52f3eb6e6ee01ecc1416d51dffedde0c22db62ff. Only the declared Learn host, key-location host, published build directory, and test fixture route shape may differ; receipt, retry, cache, URL, filesystem, and at-least-once semantics remain byte-identical.

Install the approved public Cloudflare Web Analytics token once through Docusaurus' shared document script configuration as an unversioned type=module beacon. Verify exactly one beacon in every rendered HTML artifact, including root, docs, generated indexes, blog, search, and redirect output, without edge configuration, secrets, noindex, content, or sitemap changes.

accepted_review_corrections.contract: The root route is a useful server-rendered landing page with accurate metadata and exactly one H1, remains sitemap-eligible, and the functional blog page has exactly one H1 while remaining sitemap-excluded.
accepted_review_corrections.acceptance: The sitemap contains 1980 URLs with lastmod on every URL; the root and blog render one H1 each.

accepted_review_corrections.contract: Public routes never emit a noindex robots directive. Sitemap exclusion is a separate discovery choice: blog, search, and the canonical ask-netdata replacement route remain excluded, while all current self-canonical libnetdata references remain included and indexable.
accepted_review_corrections.acceptance: Every rendered HTML file contains zero noindex directives; all current libnetdata routes occur exactly once in the sitemap; blog, search, and ask-netdata remain absent from it.

accepted_review_corrections.contract: Full ingest and grid-only recovery use one reconciliation and finalization path. The path removes stale owned grids and pagination pages, reconciles generated category metadata, cleans redirects after generated routes exist, normalizes ordering, and applies content finalizers.
accepted_review_corrections.acceptance: Grid-only recovery is byte-equivalent to a clean full-ingest grid subset for identical inputs across no-op, source removal, eligibility changes, pagination shrink and growth, overview/category transitions, redirect shadows, and recoverable grid corruption. Repeated recovery is a fixed point.

accepted_review_corrections.contract: A generated grid page holds at most 175 cards and every integration card appears on exactly one page. Overwrite and deletion authority requires generated_grid_page: true in front matter.
accepted_review_corrections.acceptance: Boundary tests cover 0, 1, 175, 176, 400, and 401 cards; the real 179-card Device Metrics grid is complete; authored no-marker files survive every reconciliation mutation.

accepted_review_corrections.contract: Offline recovery loads an exact-schema state written by full ingest, validates its canonical full-ingest identity, and validates both the upstream map identity and the non-generated source-corpus identity before changing files.
accepted_review_corrections.acceptance: Missing, malformed, duplicate, or source-corpus-drifted state fails closed; the current full-ingest state validates and recovers all owned grid artifacts.

accepted_review_corrections.contract: Grid recovery treats the configured docs root as a hard filesystem boundary. Every input and artifact path must have non-symlink ancestors under the real root and must be an expected regular file or absent leaf before it is read, hashed, written, replaced, or deleted.
accepted_review_corrections.acceptance: Dangling and existing leaf symlinks, symlinked directories, non-regular files, category artifacts, state inputs, and source-corpus entries fail before any external target or corpus artifact changes.

accepted_review_corrections.contract: One-line installer controls use React's server-stable ID mechanism and preserve unique label bindings across repeated instances.
accepted_review_corrections.acceptance: Repeated same-method instances have unique bound IDs, server rendering is repeatable, and two unchanged production builds are byte-identical.

accepted_review_corrections.contract: The rendered-link gate rejects exact and terminal-wildcard Netlify redirect sources, including same-host HTTP links; unquoted href attributes remain outside the parser because Docusaurus emits quoted attributes.
accepted_review_corrections.acceptance: Current rendered output has no redirect-source links and regression mutations cover exact, encoded, terminal-wildcard, HTTP, slash, and quoted-attribute boundaries.

accepted_review_corrections.contract: Netlify rules are one-hop and terminal under first-match order. The exact /docs/network-flows root precedes one terminal wildcard that preserves the suffix; generated rules subsumed or shadowed by static authority are omitted. Locale and cloud wildcard classes are replaced only by exact archived requests with proved current destinations.
accepted_review_corrections.acceptance: All 42 routes moved by commit 7c5a438543 resolve to the same suffix under /docs/network-performance-monitoring/network-flows; every exact internal target renders; no source shadows a rendered route; and the graph has no duplicate or conflicting identity, malformed source, chain, cycle, non-terminal wildcard, or earlier-rule shadow. Mutation tests cover every failure class and wildcard counterexamples.

accepted_review_corrections.contract: scripts/site-build-gate is an exact canonical export from netdata/seo commit 0849022df128b87ad0ae0a829a5e444408e4937f. Netlify's one build command installs its exact lock with Node 22 before Docusaurus builds, then scans build/ for every context using https://learn.netdata.cloud and a non-widening site baseline.
accepted_review_corrections.acceptance: The SEO owner verifier proves byte identity; a clean npm ci succeeds; mutation tests fail closed; two identical production builds produce the same bytes; and the complete C8 report has an empty accepted-finding baseline.

accepted_review_corrections.contract: The Learn plugin is the complete website-owned schema-2 vendor contract from commit 52f3eb6e6ee01ecc1416d51dffedde0c22db62ff. All five checksum-covered artifacts, exact root and plugin dependencies, verifier, receipt validation, and adversarial tests are copied together. Adaptation is limited to learn.netdata.cloud and Docusaurus build/ route fixtures.
accepted_review_corrections.acceptance: The schema-2 checksum verifier passes, all owner contract cases pass against the Learn host and route layout, receipt and durable recovery behavior is unchanged, and the production hook remains non-fatal with at-least-once evidence.

accepted_review_corrections.contract: Docusaurus' shared HTML script configuration emits one defer type=module Cloudflare beacon with the approved zone-level public token. The source remains unversioned and has no integrity attribute; the token is public and no Cloudflare credential enters the repository.
accepted_review_corrections.acceptance: Every rendered HTML file, including each route class and redirect output, contains exactly one manual beacon and token, while the zero-noindex, sitemap, content, and edge contracts remain unchanged.
